purpose: Teach: 櫻井/杉本/鳩山/齋藤/佐伯/中谷/中井/川島

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、新任の櫻井部長を歓迎しろ
lines.en: Welcome our new department head, Sakurai.
lines.style: Measured, authoritative opening. Crisp enunciation on the directive. Brief, no embellishment. The tone of a leader stating fact, not suggestion.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。営業の杉本課長の出張日程を整えます
lines.en: Understood. I'll coordinate Sales Manager Sugimoto's travel schedule.
lines.style: Efficient, respectful affirmation. Quick intake of breath. No hesitation — ready to execute. Tone is attentive but not anxious.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、政界の鳩山系列との関係を慎重に維持しろ
lines.en: Maintain our relationship with the Hatoyama faction carefully. Political sensitivity required.
lines.style: Deliberate, measured. Weight on 'carefully.' Lower register, almost conversational despite the formality. This is instruction wrapped in wisdom, not mere protocol.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。広報の齋藤様の戦略を採用します
lines.en: Understood. I'll implement PR Manager Saito's strategy.
lines.style: Crisp confirmation. Slight nod in the voice. Professional but engaged — he's tracking the priority.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、顧問の佐伯様にご助言を仰げ
lines.en: Consult with Advisor Saeki on this. Get his counsel.
lines.style: Direct but respectful. Pause before the name, emphasizing the specific person. Trust is audible in the delegation.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。経理の中谷様に予算策定を依頼します
lines.en: Understood. I'll ask Accounting Manager Nakaya to prepare the budget proposal.
lines.style: Quick, assured response. No drag. He's already mentally moving to the next task. Efficient without being curt.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、人事の中井様に新人研修を任せろ
lines.en: Put the new employee training under HR Manager Nakai. That's her responsibility now.
lines.style: Firm, final. Light emphasis on 'responsibility.' This is a clear delegation with weight behind it. No room for drift.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。法務の川島様に契約書確認を依頼します
lines.en: Understood. I'll have Legal Manager Kawashima review the contract documentation.
lines.style: Steady completion. Breath slightly settled, like wrapping up the list. Professional but with a subtle sense of 'all noted.' The final confirmation.
